Great Bar
Oct 2024 • Couples
We found the Xupito Bar just off the intersection with Beer Street in Hanoi . A great little Bar , serving cheap cold Beers , great food , excellent Host , great friendly staff . We made a point of having a Drink & a snack here every day of our 4 night stay in Hanoi . Not as hectic as most of the Bars around this area . Highly recommended .
Insider tip:
Get in early for the best seats

Great little cafe for brunch, lunch or light bite
Apr 2024 • Family
Great little cafe for lunch. Inexpensive and has a fewmexucan options alongside Vietnamese dishes. Fun little place, in the heart of the old quarter. Good place to view the hustle and bustle of the street outside
Insider tip:
Our group chose all the Mexican dishes together with a couple of Vietnamese dishes to share for lunch. Cheap and delicious

Delicious
Mar 2023 • Couples
We ordered the beer nachos and the beef tacos. Both were good for 1 person each, it was awesome. The lady working turned the AC on for our table and it was a nice little spot to people watch at “beer corner”. We went during the day so it wasn’t madness. Good pricing and good Mexican food and flavors. Would recommend a lot! A cute little place to enjoy Mexican food.
